__comment: Per-tenant operational dashboard. Surfaces per-tenant request rate, IOPS share, storage growth, and hot-spot indicator. Feeds the relocation decision per ADR-04 + automation-tiers.md Tier 2d. The dashboard is deliberately read-only: it shows the operator who is hot, not which tenant to move — that decision needs scheduling context the dashboard does not have.

panels.title: Top 10 tenants by request rate
panels.description: Per-tenant request rate over the last 5 minutes, sorted high-to-low. The top of this list is where customer impact is concentrated. Sudden new entry to the top means a tenant has changed traffic shape — investigate before the cell saturates.

panels.title: Top 10 tenants by IOPS share (% of cell capacity)
panels.description: Per-tenant share of the cell's EBS IOPS. A tenant above 70% is the hot-spot definition in automation-tiers.md Tier 2d. Sustained 70%+ means the tenant is starving the rest of the cell — relocation candidate.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (tenant_id) (rate(tenant_iops_total[5m])) / on(cell_id) group_left sum by (cell_id) (cell_iops_capacity) * 100)

panels.title: Per-tenant storage growth — last 24h
panels.description: Storage delta per tenant over the last 24 hours. Used for capacity-plan forecasting. A tenant with sustained growth above the cell's headroom budget is the cell-expansion trigger per ADR-04 + automation-tiers.md Tier 2c.

panels.title: Hot-spot indicator — tenants over threshold
panels.description: Count of tenants currently above the 70% IOPS or storage threshold. Zero means no hot-spot. Above zero is the trigger to consult the relocation runbook. The number does not mean those tenants will move — that is a scheduling decision.

panels.title: Relocation eligibility — tenants by readiness
panels.description: Per-tenant readiness for relocation: backup-fresh, no in-flight write, target cell has headroom. Operators read this panel before triggering scripts/relocation/per-tenant-relocate.sh. A tenant flagged ineligible has a specific reason in the table label.
